name: sorcha-mcp
description: Sorcha MCP server — drives credential issuance, blueprint design, and participant workflows for the Sorcha platform.

admin.description: Platform-administration tools — health checks, log queries, tenant and user management, validator status. Use this slice when an agent has admin scope.

designer.description: Blueprint authoring tools — create, validate, simulate, diff, export blueprints. Use this slice for workflow authoring agents.

participant.description: Participant workflow tools — submit actions, query the inbox, sign transactions, query the register. Use this slice for end-user-facing agents.
